inputs.text: A ceasefire should mean real protection for families and a return to order—not pressure on Israel to accept danger in the name of “power imbalance.” Nations have a duty to defend their people, and Iran cannot be allowed to evade accountability. Any lasting peace must restrain the forces driving this conflict and respect the security and sovereignty of both sides.
